;Armed conflicts and attacks
*A group of unknown assailants [[assassinate]] prominent [[Iraq]]i historian and [[government of Iraq|government]] advisor [[Hisham al-Hashimi]] near his home in [[Zayouna]], [[Baghdad]]. No group has claimed responsibility for his killing. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-iraq-security/gunmen-kill-prominent-iraqi-analyst-and-advisor-officials-idUKKBN2472KA?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[New Zealand]] [[news media]] company [[Stuff (company)|Stuff]] announces it will temporarily stop posting articles to [[Facebook]] and [[Instagram]], saying they have not done enough to address [[fake news]], [[hate speech]], and [[false advertising]].  [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jul/06/new-zealands-stuff-newspaper-group-joins-facebook-boycott-as-experiment (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.stuff.co.nz/business/industries/122048365/stuff-stops-all-activity-on-facebook-in-trial-inspired-by-principle (Stuff)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Kyushu floods]]
**The death toll from [[flood]]s in [[Kyushu]], [[Japan]], rises to 49 people. The country is bracing for more heavy rain. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/07/06/national/japan-floods-kumamoto/ (''The Japan Times'')]
*More than 400 people are evacuated from their homes in [[Iloilo City]] in the [[Philippines]] after an explosion on a [[power barge]] caused an oil spill. [https://apnews.com/479bfbfaf16db51092b87e3dfef13944 (AP)]
*An overturned [[fuel tanker]] catches fire while dozens of people were attempting to siphon off fuel, killing seven people and injuring more than 40 others, near [[Pueblo Viejo, Magdalena]] in northern [[Colombia]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-53315458 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] records 24,000 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, surpassing [[Russia]] to become the country with the third highest number of cases in the world at 697,413 cases. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-53303870 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Qatar]]
****Qatar exceeds 100,000 cases, becoming one of the world's highest per capita infections, having a population of 2.8 million. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/qatar-coronavirus-cases-exceed-100000-kuwait-tops-50000-200706132240959.html (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kuwait]]
****Kuwait surpasses 50,000 infections after reporting 538 new cases in the past 24 hours. Its death toll jumps to 373. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/qatar-coronavirus-cases-exceed-100000-kuwait-tops-50000-200706132240959.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (U.S. state)|COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia]]
****[[Atlanta, Georgia|Atlanta]] Mayor [[Keisha Lance Bottoms]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/06/politics/keisha-lance-bottoms-coronavirus-positive-test/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in West Virginia]]
****West Virginia Governor [[Jim Justice]] issues an order mandating [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|masks]] in indoor public spaces to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.nbcnews.com/video/west-virginia-governor-orders-face-masks-required-in-indoor-public-spaces-87099973988 (NBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020|Philippine Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020]]
**Two lawyer groups file petitions to the [[Supreme Court of the Philippines|Philippine Supreme Court]] to question the constitutionality of the recent anti-[[terrorism in the Philippines|terrorism]] law. Opposition lawmaker [[Edcel Lagman]], who contributed to one of the petitions, claims that the law's "imprecise and vague definitions" make its enforcement susceptible to infringements on certain [[civil liberties]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/philippine-court-asked-annul-duterte-backed-anti-terror-law-200706061933515.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**A court in [[Hong Kong]] denies bail to Tong Ying-kit, a 23-year-old man who was arrested last week for driving a motorbike into police officers and carrying a [[separatist]] banner. Also, prominent pro-democracy activists [[Joshua Wong]] and [[Agnes Chow]] appear in court. Wong pleads not guilty to inciting others to participate in an unlawful assembly last year while Chow pleads guilty to similar charges. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-court-denies-bail-to-first-person-charged-under-new-law-idUSKBN2470YH (Reuters)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]], [[censorship in China]]
**In [[Beijing]], authorities arrest [[Xu Zhangrun]], a law professor who published essays strongly criticizing [[Communist Party of China|Chinese Communist Party]] [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China|general secretary]] [[Xi Jinping]] over censored academia on the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] and accusing him of ruling "tyrannically." [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/china-arrests-law-professor-criticised-xi-coronavirus-200706105910775.html (Al Jazeera)]
*Spain's [[Audiencia Nacional]] agrees to extradite former [[CEO]] of [[PEMEX]] [[Emilio Lozoya Austin]] to Mexico where he is wanted on charges of bribery and [[money laundering]]. He denies any wrongdoing. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-pemex-ceo-extradition/spain-court-approves-extradition-of-former-pemex-boss-to-mexico-idUSKBN2471CO?il=0 (Reuters)]
*Former [[Prime Minister of Mongolia]] [[Jargaltulgyn Erdenebat]] is sentenced to six years in prison and banned from government work for six years from working in government office accused of abuse of power. [https://news.mn/en/793316/ (News.mn)]
;Politics and elections 
*[[2020 Brazilian municipal elections]]; [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
**The [[Government of Brazil|Brazilian]] [[National Congress of Brazil|Congress]] and [[Superior Electoral Court]] announce the postponement of this year's municipal elections to November 15 (first round) and 29 (second round) due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2020/07/aposadiamento-de-eleicao-tse-posterga-prazos-eleitorais-de-julho-em-42-dias.shtml (''Folha de S. Paulo'')]

;Science and technology
*[[2020 in spaceflight]]
**[[Israel Aerospace Industries]] successfully launches the [[Ofeq|Ofeq-16]] [[reconnaissance satellite]] via a [[Shavit]] rocket. The [[Israeli Defense Ministry]] describes the satellite as an "optoelectronic reconnaissance satellite with advanced capabilities". [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-launches-reconnaissance-satellite-into-space/ (''Times of Israel'')]
